title: CZ on "Freedom of Money" and Future of Crypto: Unfiltered AMA with Binance
description:
*“What would you ask CZ if you had the mic after reading his new memoir "Freedom of Money"?”* In this April 2026 Binance Square AMA, CZ takes live questions on his new memoir Freedom of Money, where he’s focused now, and where crypto is headed. From the origin of the four‑hand sign and life lessons (“when you’re at the bottom of a valley, keep walking”) to why he published now, how he evaluates founders, and why he’s still extremely bullish on blockchain’s long‑term role in global finance, this is CZ unfiltered—plus two live book giveaways.

📚 Resources:
➡️ Freedom of Money (book): https://www.amazon.com/Freedom-Money-Protecting-Resilience-Founding-ebook/dp/B0GHL761FP

*In this AMA, CZ covers:*
✅ Where CZ’s focused now: advising founders, passive investing; no new startup plans; learning AI; YZi Labs investing in AI, robotics, biotech, and crypto
✅ Founder lessons: control risk, expect failures, build skills across tech and sales, provide real value; everyone’s journey is different
✅ Resilience playbook: “keep walking,” change habits if you’re stuck; save consistently; learn something every day
✅ Writing the memoir: long editing grind, be brutally honest even if it offends; use your own voice to counter misperceptions and gain personal closure
✅ Chinese edition & publishing: simplified‑Chinese path via local publisher; piracy realities; Kindle vs. China economics; proceeds directed to charity
✅ Investing framework: prefer mission‑driven founders, bear‑market builders, reasonable valuations; look for GitHub commits and multi‑cycle longevity
✅ Behind the scenes at Binance: early team slept in the office; 24/7/365 ops are physically demanding
✅ Advice to young people: there are more opportunities than ever—develop one core skill, branch out, use AI; spend more time learning than doom‑scrolling
✅ Why publish now: tell the story directly, counter negative narratives, be transparent about mistakes and wins
✅ Macro view: can’t predict prices short/medium term, but remains extremely bullish on blockchain—future finance runs on chain (stablecoins, FX, commodities), and AI agents will transact natively with crypto
